key.name: edge
key.summary: Screen edge the notch is welded to

key.name: position
key.summary: Where along the edge the notch sits (0 = start, 1 = end)

key.name: color
key.summary: Colour of the notch and card body, as #rrggbb

key.name: opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the notch and card body

key.name: scale
key.summary: Size multiplier for the whole surface

key.name: text-scale
key.summary: Extra size multiplier for text only (percent labels and the card)

key.name: show-labels
key.summary: Show the percent label under each ring

key.name: always-open
key.summary: Keep the notch unfolded instead of folding to a pill

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide while a fullscreen window is on the notch's monitor

key.name: hot-zone
key.summary: Depth in pixels of the strip along the edge that opens the notch

key.name: open-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds the pointer must dwell in the strip before the notch opens
